method: Every verified picture effect was rendered at 1080x1920, 30 fps, at its default parameters, on two real vertical talking-head clips (and on a synthetic green screen for keying), and judged at three moments. These 50 read clearly on a phone, keep faces and captions intact, and look finished at their defaults. The rest stay verified and usable; they were too subtle at default on this footage, too niche, or a stronger version of the same job is featured.
